# Upscaler

> Agrandisseur d'images par IA, 100 % navigateur, par Binks Design. Il agrandit photos, logos et illustrations jusqu'à ×8 (ou à une largeur précise) avec 16 modèles d'IA (Real-ESRGAN, UltraSharp, ClearReality, RealPLKSR, Nomos2, Swin2SR, APISR…) plus Bicubique et Pixel art : avant/après, retouche en direct (force de l'IA, netteté, grain), export PNG, JPEG ou WebP à 72/150/300 dpi, ZIP pour un lot. Aucune clé API, aucun compte ; les images ne sont jamais envoyées (seuls le moteur ONNX Runtime Web et les modèles sont téléchargés depuis jsDelivr et Hugging Face).
> AI image upscaler, browser-only, by Binks Design. It enlarges photos, logos and illustrations up to ×8 (or to an exact width) with 16 AI models plus Bicubic and Pixel art: before/after view, live retouch, PNG/JPEG/WebP export at 72/150/300 DPI, ZIP for batches. No API key, no account; images are never uploaded (only the ONNX Runtime Web engine and the models are downloaded).

AI agents (Claude Code, Codex, Hermes, OpenCode, browser agents) should use the public JavaScript API window.BinksyAPI in app.html (apiVersion 1): await BinksyAPI.describe() lists the tools; importer({files:[{name,type,dataBase64}]}), choisirModele, regler, agrandir (waits for the end), exporter({format:'png'|'jpeg'|'webp', scope:'one'|'all'}) → {files:[{name,type,dataBase64}]} (no download unless download:true); errors reject with {code,message}. The same tools are registered as WebMCP tools (upscaler_*) when the browser supports document.modelContext. Setup (WebMCP, Playwright MCP, prompt): mcp/. The UI can also be driven through stable selectors: #file, .m-card[data-id], #factorSeg, #customW, #runBtn, #toast, #dims, #fmtSeg, #dpiSeg, #exportOne, #runAll, #exportZip. An internal object window.UP (items, cur, S, Engine, pickModel, run) can be read for state; it is not a stable API.
Serve the folder over http (python3 -m http.server) and open app.html with a desktop viewport (≥ 900 px wide). An Internet connection is needed for the engine and model downloads. Imported images, the current image and each image's latest upscaled result are saved across reloads (IndexedDB binks-upscaler-files), as are settings (localStorage binks-upscaler-v1).

Golden rule: enlarge the user's files only; never invent or redraw an image or logo, never present an upscale as a vector, and respect model licences (5 models are non-commercial).
